incident_name: US Gov West 1 - Compute (Partial Service Disruption)
incident_description:
Between 14 April 2026 17:50 UTC and 14 April 2026 19:21 UTC, customers using Classic Compute and Jobs Compute in AWS us-gov-west-1 may have experienced failures when attempting to start clusters.     

Between 14 April 2026 19:06 UTC and 14 April 2026 20:05 UTC, customers using Serverless Compute in AWS us-gov-west-1 may experienced failures when attempting to start clusters.                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
Symptoms:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  Customers may have observed:                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  - Clusters failing to start                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - Jobs and automated workloads failing to progress due to cluster start failures                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
 Current Status :                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
This incident has been fully resolved as of 14 April 2026 19:21 UTC. 

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.
                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
 Next Update :                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
 No further updates are planned unless conditions change.

Impact Summary

Between 14 April 2026 02:04 UTC and 14 April 2026 02:10 UTC, customers using Databricks in multiple regions experienced authentication failures.

Symptoms

Customers experienced:
- Failures to authenticate or log in to Databricks
- Disruption to Compute and other services requiring authentication

Current Status

This incident has been fully resolved as of 14 April 2026 02:10 UTC. Normal service operation has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com, or submit a support request with your cloud provider.

Next Update

No further updates are planned unless conditions change.
